PairSeparation_mm.physical_note: Wire-to-wire centre distance. Larger separation reduces mutual inductive coupling (decreasing M) and reduces inter-wire capacitance (decreasing C). Dominant control parameter for both EMC properties.

PairPitch_mm.physical_note: Twist pitch of the pair. Shorter pitch improves field cancellation, reducing effective mutual inductance. Has moderate effect on capacitance through wire spacing geometry.

Overlap_mm.physical_note: Length of parallel run between pairs. Mutual inductance scales nearly linearly with overlap (more parallel conductor = more flux linkage). No significant effect on per-metre capacitance (hence excluded from cap model).

highest_predicted.method_note: Simplified marginal contribution approximation. Not equivalent to exact SHAP values but provides directional attribution. Describes model behaviour, not physical causation.
